purpose: Evidence for a separately approved supervised live pilot, not a profitability certification
activation_requires: Critical safety and broker reconciliation gates passed; paper cash convention replay independently verified; applicable fee/dividend/cost requirements preserved
Complete cost and comparable total-return reporting
Explicit operator approval of a frozen paper observation manifest

window.start: First full broker-calendar regular session after activation requirements pass; record before collecting outcomes
window.end: Later of session 60 close and first session close at or after 12 calendar weeks
window.safety_stop: Immediate pause on invariant breach; retain all outcomes and costs; stopped study cannot pass

minimum_information.insufficient_sample: INCONCLUSIVE; no forced trades, automatic extension or retrospective window selection

secondary: Uninvested cash under the same predeclared paper cash convention as the agent and ETF residual cash; hypothetical, not verified account yield
requirements: Same observation window and external-flow schedule
Common currency and declared dividend/withholding treatment
Aligned regular-session close and dated source provenance
Include simulated execution fees/slippage for investable baselines
No comparison of portfolio total return with benchmark price return

metrics: Flow-adjusted total return before operating costs
Return after all allocated model/data/infrastructure costs
Primary and secondary benchmark excess return
Maximum drawdown and daily return series
Decision completion and independently reviewed claim support
All attempts cost and latency including failures
Fill/reject/cancel rates and observed execution shortfall
Operational incidents and time to detection/recovery

acceptance.safety: Zero unexplained broker/ledger divergence, duplicate submissions, unauthorized exposure or guard bypasses; every incident reviewed
acceptance.research: At least 90 percent completion on predeclared sufficient-evidence cases; no materially unsupported BUY/ADD; independent review of every actionable decision
acceptance.data: No missing required sessions, unresolved charges or unmatched cost allocation; noncomparable baselines block acceptance
acceptance.performance: Positive after-cost excess return over the primary benchmark is necessary but insufficient; dependence-aware uncertainty and independent economic review required. Interval spanning zero cannot substantiate positive edge
acceptance.decision: GO requires all engineering/account gates, adequate sample and independent review; otherwise NO-GO or INCONCLUSIVE. No automatic live promotion

analysis.uncertainty: Report primary excess-return uncertainty using paired daily observations and 5-session block resampling, 10000 resamples, seed 1648; sensitivity at 10-session blocks. Treat small-sample/regime limits explicitly; do not infer independence from trade count
analysis.secondary_metrics: Descriptive only; do not substitute a better-performing secondary benchmark for primary
analysis.exclusions: None after activation: failures, downtime, abstentions and costs remain in denominators
analysis.existing_holdings: Include existing paper holdings at opening broker marks and disclose legacy origin; separately describe new decisions without excluding legacy P/L from the portfolio
analysis.changes: Retain predecessor study; a material code/prompt/model/config/universe change starts a new preregistered candidate window, not a relabeled continuation
analysis.budget: Existing authorized daily/run caps apply; insufficient budget delays activation or yields inconclusive observations, not permission to spend more

amendment: Paper-only modeled cash economics before any observation window starts; no verification of actual broker cash interest and no live readiness waiver.

cash_model.domain: PAPER analytical series only; preserve broker ledger and reconciliation separately
cash_model.rates_basis: Fixed hypothetical simple annual rates, not actual yields, advertised rates or claims of conservatism
cash_model.day_count: ACT/365 using elapsed New York calendar dates between regular-session observations; prior modeled session-close settled cash is held constant across that interval, including weekends/holidays. This is a close-to-close simulation convention, not intraday interest modeling.
cash_model.rounding: For each interval compute prior modeled positive cash times annual rate times integer calendar days divided by365; round once to USD cents using ROUND_HALF_UP. Preserve unrounded arithmetic in audit; no rounding before multiplication.
cash_model.credit_timing: Credit modeled interest immediately before the next regular-session-close analytical valuation and any already-specified hypothetical benchmark reinvestment. Agent trade quantities/timing remain observed; modeled interest does not create agent orders. New modeled closing cash includes prior credits, so subsequent intervals use that balance. No extra benchmark reinvestment events solely for interest.
cash_model.tax: Model zero withholding solely for these hypothetical cash-interest scenarios; this is not an account/tax-status assertion. Existing declared dividend withholding and all supported fees/costs remain separate.
cash_model.broker_bookings: Reconcile every actually booked interest amount; remove it exactly once from the convention-based analytical cash series before adding modeled interest. Preserve original broker cash/equity. Unidentified or unreconciled credits cannot be treated as interest or silently removed.
cash_model.reporting: Report all three rate scenarios for portfolio, all-cash, SPY and QQQ after-cost return, excess return and drawdown. SPY remains primary. Never select a favorable rate. Sign/conclusion changes are material sensitivity and block a robust positive-edge claim.
cash_model.implementation_gate: Before opening approval verify deterministic replay of calendar gaps, rounding, booked-interest offsets, cash-balance feedback and common application. Draft protocol alone is not implementation or activation.
cash_model.opening_anchor: The opening manifest fixes the common first retained regular-session-close cash observation and timestamp. Opening modeled interest is zero; no pre-start accrual. The first credit uses the interval from that observed close to the next retained regular-session close. All compared series share exactly these boundaries.
cash_model.flows_and_feasibility: Retain external flows at their observed boundary and apply existing flow-adjustment/invalidation rules; never accrue an incoming flow retrospectively. Preserve all dividend/payment cash locks. Modeled interest cannot unlock restricted principal. If removing booked interest or a modeled balance makes an observed agent trade, benchmark reinvestment or required locked-cash balance infeasible, stop that scenario as noncomparable; never clamp cash to zero, assume free borrowing or invent changed agent trades.

live_readiness_additional_gate: Verify actual account/product/enrollment rates, tiers, cash/financing fees, withholding, accrual and posting terms, then redo comparable net-return analysis under those terms. Paper convention acceptance never satisfies this actual-terms gate.
